senses.en_definition: Ill or unwell; affected by pain in a part of the body.
Suffering emotional pain, distress, or hardship; in sakit hati, feeling hurt, angry, or resentful.

collocations.en: emotional distress; mental illness, depending on context

messages.en: Are you still coming to dinner tonight? I'm about to book a table.
I won't be joining you after all. My stomach's been hurting for a while. You guys go ahead and eat.
Okay, get some rest. If you want me to pick up some rice porridge for you later, just let me know.
I saw what happened earlier, so I can be a witness.
That's good. If the police ask you about it later, just tell them what you saw.

senses.en_definition: Mistaken or misdirected; involving the wrong target, choice, or intended meaning.

collocations.en: there is nothing wrong with asking

senses.en_definition: A fault or wrongdoing; responsibility for an improper act or a breach of rules.
At fault or to blame; guilty of wrongdoing.
One of two or more people or things, used in combinations such as salah satu and salah seorang.

messages.en: Are you mad at me? Your replies have been really short for a while now.
Hey, don't get me wrong. I'm not mad, just a bit tired. I just got back from work.
Oh, that explains it. Get some rest. We'll chat later.
Say hi to your mum for me, okay?
I already did earlier. Mum says hi back!
